title: WorkerTask
description: Represents an individual task assignment to a specific worker as part of a daily report.

id.description: Unique identifier for the worker task.

workerId.description: Reference to User (Worker) assigned to this task.

taskId.description: Reference to the Task being performed.

dailyReportId.description: Reference to the DailyReport this task belongs to.

hours.description: Number of hours the worker spent on this task.

status.description: The current status of the task.

notes.description: Additional notes about the task execution.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the worker task was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the worker task was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
